senses.en_definition: When; whenever; introducing a clause that indicates time.

messages.en: I'm almost at your place. Where should I wait?
Just wait in the lobby. Message me when you get here, okay? I'll come down then.
Okay, I should be there in about five minutes.

senses.en_definition: What; used to ask about something's identity, meaning, purpose, cause, or nature.
Used to ask whether something is true or possible, sometimes expressing doubt.
What?; used in questions expressing surprise or disbelief.

collocations.en: what on earth is all this?

messages.en: This question asks, 'What is the purpose of this campaign?' What should I put?
The recycling campaign, right? Just write 'to encourage the public to recycle'.
Oh, just its purpose. I thought I had to describe all the activities too.

senses.en_definition: Anything; whatever; in negative constructions, anything at all.
Anyway; in any case; used to move on or introduce a point regardless of what came before.

messages.en: No idea if I'll get that job. I was so nervous earlier.
That's normal. You did your best, so just wait and see what they say.
Anyway, thanks for helping me practise last night. I felt a bit less scared after we'd practised.

senses.en_definition: Fire; the heat and light produced by burning; flame.
A red-hot glow without a flame, as at the burning tip of a cigarette.

collocations.en: the glowing tip of a cigarette
a smouldering fire beneath rice husks; figuratively, hidden danger or hostility

senses.en_definition: Electricity; the electricity supply, especially in everyday references to household utilities.
Figuratively, intense emotion, such as anger, longing, or love; burning enthusiasm or fighting spirit.

messages.en: Have you turned the stove off? I'm heading out now.
Yes, Mum. I checked earlier. All the burners are off.
